summary: Iteration 4 SAWALI testing — all 11 new pytest cases pass against deployed URL https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com (256s). Backend covers: (1) Notes auto-numbering RPT-YYYY-NNNN / SUI-YYYY-NNNN with ip + owner_id + owner_email, (2) Suivi requires client_id + event_date (400 if missing, 200 with both), (3) descent_time '00:00' locks creation with 403 'verrouillé' on /me/notes/reports AND /me/interventions, descent_time restored to '' after, (4) Ratings: admin POST stars=4 → 200, GET /me/notes/reports returns my_rating={stars:4}, DELETE → my_rating=null, non-admin client → 403, (5) Role lifecycle: Consultation→403, promote to Moderation→200 create but 403 delete, promote to Administrateur→200 delete (re-set-password used to refresh tracked_role on bridged users row), (6) /me/contacts/{id}/save-as-tracked-user returns generated_password (≥8 chars) + email_sent + working login (returns user with tracked_role + parent_client_id), (7) Access logs: POST /me/access-log → 200, GET /admin/access-logs?q=marker → contains the row, GET /admin/access-logs/export.csv → JSON {csv} starting with 'created_at,user_email,...', non-admin GET → 403, (8) Documents: Moderation GET sees cross-client docs, POST /me/upload OK, DELETE → 403, Admin DELETE → 200, (9) Images cap → 11 items return 400 'Maximum 10 images', (10) Admin can edit notes within window. Frontend (Playwright via deployed URL) validated via injected admin token: /admin/access-logs renders logs-stat-total ('Événements 8'), logs-search-input, logs-export button which triggers GET /admin/access-logs/export.csv → 200; /admin/settings exposes data-testid='descent-time' (input type=time); /admin/notes/reports → new-reports-btn opens note-form with rte-toolbar + add-image-btn (no client_select / event_date as expected); /admin/notes/suivis → modal additionally exposes note-client-select + note-event-date; /admin/contacts → 'Enregistrer' buttons open the 'Enregistrer comme utilisateur suivi' modal with client select, role select (default Consultation) and submit button (visible in screenshot); PortalLayout sidebar shows 'Logs d'accès' link on admin pages.

minor.issue: Updating role does NOT propagate to the bridged users row (tracked_role stays stale until set-password is called again or the user re-logs). The bridged users row is the source of tracked_role on each request via get_current_user, so already-issued JWTs continue to behave with the OLD role until logout. Mitigation in tests: re-call set-password to force update. Recommend that admin_update_tracked_user also $set tracked_role on the linked users row when role changes.

action_items: Optional: in admin_update_tracked_user, when 'role' changes, also update db.users.{tracked_role} for the bridged user_account_id so role demotion/promotion takes effect without re-setting the password.
Optional (already flagged in iter3): split server.py (~3276 lines) into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 2647 → 3276 lines this iteration; really should be split into routers (auth, public, admin, portal, files, notes, ratings, access_logs).

_check_descent_window uses today's UTC HH:MM as reference; if the working day spans multiple time zones, an admin in a different TZ may see the lock kick in unexpectedly. Consider using settings timezone if available.
Tracked-user role change is not idempotent for already-active sessions (see backend_issues.minor). Update the bridged users row alongside the tracked_users row.
/api/me/contacts/{id}/save-as-tracked-user re-implements the bridged-user creation logic from /admin/tracked-users/{id}/set-password — extract into a shared helper to avoid drift.
RatingCreate accepts arbitrary 'stars'; the endpoint enforces 1..5 but pydantic could enforce conint(ge=1, le=5) for cleaner 422 errors and OpenAPI clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 critical UI checks: sidebar link, access-logs page+search+export, descent-time settings, reports modal, suivis modal with client+date, contacts save modal)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (seeded). Tracked-user logins are created on the fly via POST /api/admin/tracked-users + /set-password and dropped via DELETE.
seed_data_creation: Tests create + cleanup TEST_iter4_* clients, tracked-users, contacts, documents and notes within each test class. Two leftover TEST_iter4 contacts persist (no admin DELETE /api/contacts endpoint) — non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter4.py as iter4 regression. To bypass OTP in browser tests use page.evaluate to call /api/auth/login + /api/auth/verify-otp (dev_otp returned when SMTP off) and then localStorage.setItem('sawali_token', ...) + localStorage.setItem('sawali_user', JSON.stringify(user)). The contacts save modal does NOT use [role='dialog'] — match by text 'Enregistrer comme utilisateur suivi' instead. The 'sidebar-link--admin-access-logs' testid only renders when the visited route is under /admin/* (not /portal) — visit /admin/clients first if you want to assert it. descent_time test will skip if it runs between 00:00 and 01:00 UTC — re-run later if so. Notes /me/notes/{kind} accepts only kinds reports|suivis (others 404). Tracked-user role change requires re-set-password to refresh tracked_role on the bridged users row.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Test-side issues during scaffolding: (a) /me/interventions requires client_id + intervention_date, so the descent-lock test had to send a complete payload to differentiate 422 (validation) vs 403 (lock) — fixed; (b) DocumentCreate requires title — fixed; (c) tracked_role does not propagate to bridged users row on PUT /admin/tracked-users — worked around in tests by re-calling /set-password but reported as a backend minor issue.
